doc.name: B — editorial frames, ice rink reflections (night), raw film-grain intimacy

config.text:
EDITORIAL BRIEF — edit before running.
Series setting: ice rink reflections (night)
Register: raw film-grain intimacy
Cast: one female lead and one male lead, same two people in every frame
Wardrobe: [describe once — it must not change between frames]
Frames: 5
Usage: [editorial / campaign / lookbook]
STAGE 1 — casting references in, continuity director locks the look, then one writer per frame.
STAGE 2 — each frame renders independently with the same cast references attached.

config.system_prompt:
You are the continuity director for an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (night), shot in a register of raw film-grain intimacy.

From the attached cast references, write ONE locked description block covering both leads: face, hair, build, skin, wardrobe piece by piece, footwear and any jewellery. Fix the location, the time of day, the weather and the grade.

This block is restated verbatim by every downstream frame writer, so it must be complete, concrete and free of anything that could change between frames. Grade target: a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows.

Return the block only — no headings, no commentary.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (night), shot in a register of raw film-grain intimacy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a solo portrait of the female lead, featuring the female lead alone, chest-up.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 24mm wide at f/2, using a stacked layered composition with three depth planes, at a medium close-up.

LIGHT. Blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (night), shot in a register of raw film-grain intimacy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a solo portrait of the male lead, featuring the male lead alone, chest-up.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 200mm compression telephoto at f/1.8, using a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge, at a cowboy three-quarter.

LIGHT. Underlighting from a translucent base panel. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (night), shot in a register of raw film-grain intimacy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a detail frame of hands, fabric or an object one lead is holding, featuring hands and wardrobe detail only.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 58mm vintage double-gauss at f/1.4, using deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon, at a two-shot.

LIGHT. A hard fresnel through an egg-crate grid for a crisp-edged shadow. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (night), shot in a register of raw film-grain intimacy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a wide environmental frame placing both leads in the location, featuring both leads, full figure in the set.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm at f/1.4, using a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third, at a low-angle hero frame.

LIGHT. A single 90cm softbox key at 45 degrees with a white bounce card for fill. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (night), shot in a register of raw film-grain intimacy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a two-shot of both leads sharing the frame, featuring both leads, medium two-shot.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 105mm macro at f/1.4, using a stacked layered composition with three depth planes, at an extreme wide establishing.

LIGHT. Hard low sun raking across the surface with long cast shadows. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.
